import json,time,hashlib,pathlib
from vllm import LLM,SamplingParams
model='/models/Qwen3-0.6B'
start=time.time()
engine=LLM(model=model,tensor_parallel_size=1,max_model_len=2048,gpu_memory_utilization=0.2,enforce_eager=True,trust_remote_code=True,max_num_seqs=4)
prompts=['The capital of France is','Calculate 2 + 3. Answer:']
params=SamplingParams(temperature=0,max_tokens=32,seed=42)
outputs=engine.generate(prompts,params)
rows=[{'prompt':o.prompt,'prompt_token_ids':o.prompt_token_ids,'text':o.outputs[0].text,'token_ids':o.outputs[0].token_ids,'finish_reason':o.outputs[0].finish_reason} for o in outputs]
assert len(rows)==2 and all(r['token_ids'] and r['text'].strip() for r in rows)
print('HEYI_NATIVE_RESULT='+json.dumps({'model':model,'tp':1,'max_model_len':2048,'gpu_memory_utilization':0.2,'enforce_eager':True,'elapsed_seconds':time.time()-start,'outputs':rows}),flush=True)
